subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining fix be a narrow Telegram plain-group updateLastRoute repair, or a broader shared non-direct delivery-context fallback?
rationale: Both directions are plausible from source inspection, but the shared fallback changes cross-channel session routing behavior while the narrow Telegram fix may leave adjacent non-direct channel gaps unresolved.

options.title: Prove And Fix Telegram Plain Groups
options.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in the Telegram plugin without changing shared fallback behavior unless proof points there.

options.title: Adopt Shared Fallback
options.body: Make the shared recorder derive non-direct delivery context when callers omit updateLastRoute after compatibility review across channel plugins.

options.title: Wait For Live Evidence
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on current-main Telegram restart proof before choosing either implementation boundary.

recommendation.title: Prove And Fix Telegram Plain Groups
recommendation.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof, then persist the group last route in the Telegram plugin without changing shared fallback behavior unless proof points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder history and the recent merge path that carried the current Telegram/session code forward.
